title.narrative: Sustainable and Reliable Energy Access Program - Western and Central Java

description.narrative: $600 million results-based loan to help state-owned power company Perusahaan Listrik Negara (PLN) provide affordable, sustainable, and reliable electricity to about 112 million people living in the western and central parts of Java island while also promoting the use of clean energy.
